name: Guangzhou functional area
limitations: Eight dimensions and31 subpillars reviewed at conditional/partial levels, not fully measured. PCS/GSS/ISR/RES/MED60, TEC80, OPT40; LON unresolved gives mathematical domain54-64 without a total centre, reliable exclusion bound or shortlist proof. The frozen9711 includes part of Foshan, not all Guangzhou or Foshan jurisdictions; healthcare payer boundaries persist inside the same functional area. Locality, continuity, usual legal qualification/coverage, affordability and residual materiality assumptions are reversible. Missing is not zero or negative transparency evidence; full9031 and outside-frame competitors remain. MED60 accepted after the2026-10-13 review; withdrawal restores MED/LON unknown domain45-70. The score is conditional on named locality, quality-continuity, usual insurance/affordability and residual-access assumptions.

dimensions.rationale: Cooling actually used by exposed sanitation workers and2026 operation, storm pumps and protected core facilities coexist with recurring residential sewage flooding, geological-risk tasks and a Foshan business-building inundation followed by actual overnight multi-organization recovery. Plans and drainage design are not completed household protection.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped core protection and delivered mitigation as representative of9711 ordinary residents, continuing through cutoff with important weaknesses but no wider persistent important unmitigated necessary-living bottleneck. More evidence of important residual household/heat/geological/underground disruption could support40; stronger effective protection/affordable backup80. Reject scope/resident/continuity/residual-materiality assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: The court own2025 report records a March20 final judgment against13 defendants for historical long-running village control and organized coercion in Shachongbei. Actual verdict is not all victims restored or current population violence rate. South China Sea patrols and Taiwan Strait exercises remain regional context, not Guangzhou attacks; actual2025 civil-defense exercise participation is not wartime full capacity.
dimensions.assumption: Accept current ordinary-life and core-route impact as relatively limited and enforcement/response normally usable after reviewed action despite retained historical harm and regional threats. Continuing important coercion or regional/strategic channel blockage could support40; broader low impact and effective alternatives80. Reject time/locality/ordinary reach/impact assumptions to restore unknown; no matched event does not establish safety.

dimensions.rationale: Actual legal remedy processing, worker assistance, school-fee refunds and difficult-resident contact, drainage dispatch and overnight storm response establish functioning delivery. Repeated residential flooding and self-funded cleanup, school implementation gaps, and39 earlier penalties with further illegal LPG activity expose real execution failures.100% inspection/closed findings did not prevent missed issues; proposed accountability and repair are not completed sanctions or resident compensation.
dimensions.assumption: Accept currently reachable core services and continuing scoped mitigation as adequate ordinary operation, retaining important failures and unresolved victim/household recovery tails as weaknesses without inferring wider persistent unmitigated failure. Actual remaining rights/recovery/inspection barriers could strengthen40 without majority harm; broader rights/recovery and effective alternative organizations80. Reject representativeness/continuity/recovery-materiality assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: The2026Q2 original table enumerates225 administrative-city terminal/secondary-water samples, all listed tested projects compliant, including outside9711 points; company2025 pipeline99.99% is a42-test weighted compliance metric, not household rate. Actual food trading8641t/day with8001t external vegetables and rising monitored retail prices, operating electricity and completed65km Nanhai gas-pipe works establish scoped provision. Household and urban-village gaps, external/common pathways and affordability remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept sampled/local actual water, food, energy and delivered mitigation as reasonably representative, normally usable and affordable for ordinary9711 residents continuing through cutoff. Remaining end-service, price and external/common-channel constraints are important weaknesses but not an evidenced overall important unmitigated necessities bottleneck after mitigation. More evidence of important unmet necessities/common interruption could support40; effective affordable alternatives80. Reject locality/continuity/usual affordability/residual materiality to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual single-hospital infection-control implementation and improved patient/device-day outcomes through2024 supplement existing delivered necessary specialist care, current Guangzhou/Foshan payer paths and actual processing. Old DIP costs, stroke text/table conflicts, cross-insurance qualifications and continuity limitations remain. This is conditional usual-care adequacy, not a current whole-FUA adjusted outcome measurement.
dimensions.assumption: Accept limited provider/campus and resident representativeness, continuation to cutoff, effective usual insurance branch with clinically appropriate directory/referral conditions, generally affordable timely necessary care and alternatives, and no important unmitigated residual treatment bottleneck. Guangzhou employee rules do not cover every resident; Foshan cross-city conditions remain. Reject a necessary assumption to restore MED unknown; important residual quality/payment/waiting constraints can40; stronger delivered quality and affordable continuity can80.

dimensions.rationale: Shared disease-specific randomized evidence and Chinese approval, the261-patient21-centre SAIL study and local prescription are reviewed. National patients are not local treatment counts; a prescription is not an infusion. SAIL paired50 CDR-SB5.36to6.02 deteriorated and MMSE comparison was nonsignificant; external comparison/ARIA table-text conflicts remain. The formal2026supplementary policy gives different inpatient/medicine paths, an empty current specified-innovation list and exclusions, not automatic two-antibody/monitoring coverage.
dimensions.assumption: No anchor selected while actual local administration, current ordinarily eligible resident insurance enrollment, drug-path applicability/net cost and appropriate monitoring across Guangzhou/Foshan remain unresolved. Lack of invoices or contracts itself is not40. Credible local delivered, compliant and usually affordable disease-specific path with retained maturity limits could60; actual important residual access barriers after mitigation40; wider mature accessible routes80. Usual basic coverage is not supplementary enrollment; scientific medium-AD study does not expand approved early-AD indication.

dimensions.rationale: University actual industrialization and a second university verified patent-transfer cash received250300yuan/net245300yuan, multiple technical production/applications,2025administrative industrial/digital data and real public-service transactions, online consultations and elder-assistance delivery support sustained multiple-producer capability. Cross-campus/outside buyers, transactions versus unique residents and residual skills/financing limits remain; record associations and external rankings give no score.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped institution/industry and administrative service observations as representative of9711 main production and ordinary-resident diffusion, continuing through cutoff, with delivered assistance making remaining skill/funding barriers not an important overall diffusion bottleneck. This is not every product instantly replaceable or every node stress-tested. Material residual barriers could support60, more evident production/adoption disconnection40. Reject locality/continuity/usual diffusion/mitigation assumptions to restore unknown. Cross-border connectivity remains OPT rather than duplicate TEC deduction.

dimensions.rationale: Actual airport traffic and metro/ground use establish physical channels though Baiyun airport lies in9741. The shared Chinese skilled-work pre-entry visa route is conditional, not permission already granted. Lawful current-account transactions can exceed USD50000with documents; capital-purpose/previous-permanent-status migration-asset conditions remain. A2024Guangzhou Tencent cloud test records479blocked TLS names outbound to SG/US and411US-to-Guangzhou, with domestic control0; actual household outcomes/current operator repair are unmeasured.
dimensions.assumption: Accept specific cloud-test mechanism as representative of ordinary key cross-border connections and continuing to2026, and asset-purpose/prior-status constraints as materially limiting usual relocation resources despite lawful/physical/domestic alternatives. These reversible assumptions, not missing2026tests alone, support40. Current affordable usable communication/asset/transport/legal paths with relief could60; effective alternatives and common-failure checks80. Reject locality/continuity/household/materiality assumptions to restore unknown. No basis for severe universal exit blockade or all-transfer USD50000ceiling.
